title: In-Place Home Resale Initial Inspection Charge: Desk Posting Card
content:
**Resident desk card — the initial inspection charge on an In-Place Home Resale file.** The initial pre-sale inspection of a resale file is charged once, against the initial inspection record it bills, dated on that inspection's record date. The charge becomes owed once the initial inspection is recorded on the file; re-inspections are not initial inspections and are not billed through this card.

**Effect of posting.** One posting adds one inspection-fee charge to the file's ledger, tied to the initial inspection record it bills and dated as given, and raises the fees the seller owes on the file by the amount. The seller sees the inspection fee among the file's charges and a higher fees-owed figure.

## Invocation

The desk tool is `post_inspection_fee_534473a1`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `resale_id` | the resale file number of the home being sold, as shown on the seller's resale file in the in-place resale file lookup | identifier text |
| `inspection_record_id` | the reference number of the initial inspection record being billed, as listed among the file's records in the resale record lookup | identifier text |
| `charge_date` | the date the charge is dated on the file | YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date with no time part and no time zone |
| `amount` | the inspection charge, in USD | a positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent; stored exactly as passed |

## Return

On success the tool returns a text rendering of these fields: `status` (the text "posted"), `resale_entry_id` (reference number of the new ledger charge), `resale_id` (the file charged), `charge_type` (always "inspection_fee"), `source_entry_id` (the inspection record the charge is tied to), `entry_date` (the charge date, YYYY-MM-DD), `amount` (the charge in USD with 2 decimal places) and `fees_balance` (the fees owed on the file including this charge, USD with 2 decimal places). The tool defines no other receipt.

## Questions on the card

**Which record does the charge point to?** The initial inspection record it bills, by that record's reference number.

**Which date does the charge carry?** The record date of the initial inspection it bills.

**How many inspection charges does one initial inspection carry?** One: the initial inspection is charged once.
